choices.why: It is the only dark-wood dining table among the candidates, and its clean frame base suits a classic yet current look, matching the dark staircase handrail and cabinets.
These high-back fabric chairs in a blue-grey weave have dark legs that match the table; three sets of two make the six chairs requested.
This 66 cm chandelier is large enough to centre the table, and its dark bronze and frosted glass echo the existing kitchen fixtures for a warm classic style.
This walnut-toned buffet with cane panels adds warmth and texture, sits well against the long staircase wall and matches the dark tones of the set.

answer.why: The dark wood table and buffet, the dark legs of the grey upholstered chairs and the bronze chandelier repeat the dark tones of the handrail and kitchen cabinets. The fabric and cane add warmth over the hardwood floor.
